items.statement: Each retained methyl/methylene stationary point is frequency-classified, with minima having no imaginary mode and CMD TSs having one relevant imaginary mode.
items.expected: Frequency evidence is reported for each ligand/site object.

items.statement: Retained CMD transition structures are connectivity-validated to the corresponding reactant and product-side minima.
items.expected: Bidirectional IRC or a specifically justified equivalent is reported per TS.

items.statement: The calculated methyl barriers and methyl/methylene free-energy differences reproduce the reported ligand-dependent values and trend.
items.expected: L7, L9 and L12 barrier and ratio fields are supplied with units and uncertainty.
